Landing.headline: An input that becomes what you mean.
Landing.subhead: Meanbox morphs a single text box into the right UI as you type — events, places, news, checklists, and more. Powered by TypeSafe AI's Jev. Join the waitlist for early access.
Landing.featuresSub: One morphing input for planning, places, and capture. Everything else was deliberately left out.
Landing.featureMorphDesc: One text box becomes the right UI — events, checklists, places, news, splits, and thirty-plus more — without menus or mode switches.
Landing.featureJevDesc: TypeSafe AI’s Jev classifies intent in parallel. Dates, amounts, places, and math stay in deterministic parsers.
Landing.featurePlacesDesc: Search venues on the map, pin places for later (/pinned), and save people to Lead Flow — type /contact to revisit places you’ve already captured.
Landing.featureOfflineDesc: A built-in keyword classifier keeps the demo useful with no API key. Plug in Jev when you want the full model.
Landing.ctaBody: Invites go out weekly, in the order people joined. Save your place and we'll take it from there.
Landing.noSpam: No spam, no noise. One email when we open the doors.
Landing.inviteReady: We'll email you the moment your invite is ready.
